verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a payfac or marketplace platform can be expected to document liability allocation. Nothing in the pack does so. The identity-verification doc (stripe-connect-docs-16) only says verification can 'reduce risk on your platform', and the disputes doc (stripe-connect-docs-17) only says disputes are viewable in the Dashboard. Neither states who owns KYC/AML, card-network compliance, fraud or dispute losses, or seller misconduct as between the platform and Stripe.
